scenario_name: Megacode Case 1 — Sinus Brady to VF to Asystole to ROSC

metadata.scenario_name: Megacode Case 1 — Sinus Brady to VF to Asystole to ROSC

evidence.text: Megacode scenario started by instructor
Heart rate is 38 — this is bradycardia, patient is symptomatic
HR 38 bpm, BP 72/40, SpO2 88%, rhythm: sinus bradycardia
IV access secured, right antecubital, 18G
12-lead showing sinus bradycardia, no ST changes
Patient is compromised — hypotensive, confused, diaphoretic
Atropine 1 mg IV given — Nurse confirms dose back to Dr. Anand
Sinus bradycardia confirmed — not infranodal, atropine appropriate
No pulse! He has arrested — start CPR immediately!
Compressions started — Karthik on the chest
Head-tilt chin-lift — airway opened by Dr. Samuel
BVM ventilation at 10 breaths per minute
Coarse VF on monitor
200 joules — clear! Shock delivered
CPR resumed immediately after shock
Epinephrine 1 mg IV — Divya reads back dose confirmed
Still VF — 200J again, clear, shock 2 delivered
CPR resumed — 7-second pause post-shock
Amiodarone 300 mg IV after second shock — correct timing
Third shock — 200J — still VF
Compressions back on — good pace
Rhythm changed to asystole — confirm in two leads
Second epi — 1 mg IV — confirmed by Divya
Hs and Ts — checked hypoxia, hypovolemia, tamponade, electrolytes
ETT 7.5 placed — bilateral breath sounds confirmed, EtCO2 attached
Second IV access — 16G left AC
ROSC! Organised rhythm, BP 105/70, patient responding
12-lead post-ROSC — sinus rhythm, no obvious STEMI
Targeted temperature management initiated — target 36 degrees
Megacode scenario completed successfully — ROSC achieved

segments.speaker: Instructor
segments.text: Scenario start — patient is a 58-year-old male, found unresponsive in the ward.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Heart rate 38 on the monitor — this is symptomatic bradycardia. Everyone get ready.

segments.speaker: Nurse Meera
segments.text: Noted — HR 38, BP 72/40, SpO2 88%, GCS dropping. Time is 00:08.

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: Vitals confirmed on monitor — sinus bradycardia.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: IV access in right antecubital — 18G, patent and running.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: 12-lead shows sinus bradycardia — no ST elevation or depression.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Patient is compromised — hypotension, altered mental status, signs of shock. We need to treat.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Divya — atropine 1 milligram IV please, now.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Atropine 1 mg IV — confirming back to you doctor.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Correct — give it.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Atropine 1 mg IV given. Time noted.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Block type looks like sinus bradycardia — not infranodal, atropine is appropriate.

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: HR now 45 — slight improvement but still symptomatic.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Not enough response. Rajan — prepare the defib for pacing if needed.

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: Doctor! He just went — no pulse! Monitor shows arrest!

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: No pulse confirmed — call the code! Karthik, start CPR immediately!

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: Compressions started — I am on the chest.

segments.speaker: Dr. Samuel (Airway)
segments.text: Opening airway — head tilt chin lift.

segments.speaker: Dr. Samuel (Airway)
segments.text: BVM ventilation started — 10 breaths per minute with 100% oxygen.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Coarse VF on the monitor — confirmed in two leads.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: VF confirmed — Rajan charge to 200 joules, everyone else continue CPR.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Charged to 200 joules. Ready to shock.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Stop CPR — everyone clear! Rajan — shock!

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Clear! Shock delivered — 200 joules.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Resume CPR immediately! Karthik get back on the chest!

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: Compressions resumed — good rate and depth.

segments.speaker: Nurse Meera
segments.text: Two-minute mark — time for rhythm check and compressor switch.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Divya — epinephrine 1 mg IV please. Karthik — switch with whoever is fresh.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Epinephrine 1 mg IV — confirming.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Confirmed — give it.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Epinephrine 1 mg IV given at 03:20.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Still VF — charging to 200 joules for second shock.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Stop CPR — everyone clear!

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Second shock — 200J. Clear!

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Resume CPR! Good job — 7-second pause only.

segments.speaker: Nurse Meera
segments.text: Four-minute mark — after second shock we should consider amiodarone.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Divya — amiodarone 300 mg IV now after second shock.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Amiodarone 300 mg IV — confirming the order.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Amiodarone 300 mg IV given at 05:30.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Still showing VF — third shock ready.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Stop CPR — everyone clear for third shock!

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Third shock — 200J. Delivered.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Resume CPR! Keep the rate up.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Rhythm changed — looks like asystole now. Confirm in second lead.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Asystole confirmed — continue CPR, no shock. Samuel — advanced airway now.

segments.speaker: Nurse Meera
segments.text: Asystole at 07:40. Epinephrine last given at 03:20 — due again.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Divya — second epinephrine 1 mg IV now.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Second epinephrine 1 mg IV given — confirmed at 08:00.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Let us run through reversible causes — Hs and Ts. Hypoxia? Airway is secured.

segments.speaker: Dr. Samuel (Airway)
segments.text: Hypoxia addressed — BVM with 100% O2. Hypovolemia possible — any fluid given?

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Give 500 mL normal saline fast. Check for tamponade, tension PTX, hyperkalemia.

segments.speaker: Dr. Samuel (Airway)
segments.text: ETT 7.5 in place — at 22 cm at the teeth. Bilateral breath sounds confirmed. EtCO2 attached.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Good — ventilate at 10 per minute. No hyperventilation.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Second IV access — 16G left antecubital. Fluid running.

segments.speaker: Nurse Meera
segments.text: Third epinephrine due — last given at 08:00.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Divya — third epi 1 mg IV.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Third epinephrine 1 mg IV — confirmed and given.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: EtCO2 rising — now 28 mmHg. Could be ROSC coming.

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: I can feel a pulse! Stopping compressions to check.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Everyone stop — checking pulse. Yes — strong femoral pulse! We have ROSC!

segments.speaker: Nurse Meera
segments.text: ROSC at 11:20. Total down time approximately 9 minutes 50 seconds.

segments.speaker: Nurse Rajan
segments.text: Organised rhythm on monitor — sinus rhythm, HR 78, BP 105/70.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Excellent team work. Get the 12-lead now and start post-ROSC care.

segments.speaker: Nurse Karthik
segments.text: 12-lead done — sinus rhythm, HR 80, no obvious STEMI. Printing.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Target temperature management — target 36 degrees. Contact ICU for transfer.

segments.speaker: Nurse Divya
segments.text: Temperature management initiated — cooling initiated per protocol.

segments.speaker: Dr. Anand (TL)
segments.text: Good work everyone. Let us debrief after handover. Key points: excellent CPR fraction, appropriate drug timing.

segments.speaker: Instructor
segments.text: Scenario complete. ROSC achieved. Outstanding team performance.
